note: Waterlogging reports transcribed from the cited articles. Place names are as written in each article. Coordinates are added by scripts/build-incidents.mjs from OpenStreetMap and are approximate locality centres, not the exact spots reported. Localities are mapped only when OpenStreetMap has a matching place (suburb, neighbourhood and similar); named facilities are mapped to that facility.
